question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

Superbugs are the bacteria that have accquired resistance to several types of antibiotics either through genetic mutation or through buildup resistance over time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acquired**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Accquired**" is a misspelling of the word "acquired."
 
• The correct spelling is "**acquired**," which means to gain or develop something over time. (समय के साथ कुछ हासिल करना या विकसित करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She acquired a new skill after attending the workshop.*
 
 
 
• "Acquired resistance" refers to the ability of bacteria to resist the effects of antibiotics.
 
• It can occur through genetic mutation or the gradual development of resistance over time.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence**: *Superbugs are the bacteria that have acquired resistance to several types of antibiotics either through genetic mutation or through buildup resistance over time.*
